// diagnostic

E0303

struct/variant construction field errors

What

struct/variant construction field errors

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0303

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0303: tests/ui/enum_named_payload_needs_dot_brace.stderr.

Error [E0303]: variant `Box` requires labeled fields
  --> tests/ui/enum_named_payload_needs_dot_brace.jet:6:15
    |
  6 |     v :: View.Box(10, 20)
    |               ^^^
 Why: named-payload variants construct with the dot-brace form (D-UITREE1/D-DOTCTOR1), matching struct construction
 Fix: write `View.Box.{ w: 1.0, h: 2.0 }`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0303
